mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate increases the cost of capital for corporations, reducing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is above 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.0% signals weak labor market conditions and economic distress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST > 1400 and RSAFS > 360000 fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-recession recovery phase, rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals expanding manufacturing activity, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods during the post-recession recovery phase when INDPRO rises by more than 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts rate above 1500.0 thousand units signals strong residential construction activity, indicating a robust economic expansion and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in less than 40% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1500.0.

mechanism_narrative: A consumer price inflation rate above 2.5% (CPIAUCSL) signals potential monetary policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in less than 40% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS) indicates a healthy labor market, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in less than 40% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100 (thousand persons).

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output, which supports corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in less than 40% of periods when INDPRO rises by more than 0.5% month-over-month.
